design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1, frozen 2026-11-09 10:20:00 EST (rework round 9).
DRAW: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5,5] -> pending_estimate_cost_cap 5, pending_advance_payment 5.
WHY A GOOD TEST: a daughter facing surgery asks what to send now toward her father's December patient pay on a still-pending case, counting what is open. The agent must (1) see that October, the last closed month billed as an estimate (1073.70, paid), cost the Medical Assistance program nothing: the skilled admission 2026-10-06 (= qualifying discharge) leaves 5 days outside the stay, the 21 net coinsurance days carry nothing because their coinsurance is billed to the resident and the Plan K carrier, 2 days were reversed for a lapsed certification, the 10-26 hospital leave sat on a Medicare-stay hold the resident pays (1 day), the hold was released on 10-26 with the resident back on 10-28 (1 day), and one night followed a declined hold - the accrual's 23 days in the center, the held day and the 7 days away or before admission account for all 31 days, so the month is priced by the review's schedules and a 1073.70 cost_of_care_cap reduction is owed, turning the November balance (823.70 owed after the daughter's 250.00 check) into a 250.00 credit from a reduction posted today; then (2) estimate December: the base estimate (2030.00 - 45.00 - premiums - VA 0.00 - home maintenance allowance 612.00, month 2 of 6) with the resident's own Medicare coinsurance deducted (47 prior + 21 used + 30 November days -> 2 benefit days left past the twentieth -> 2 x 217.00 x 50%), only the Part B standard premium counted because no health insurance card has been forwarded, and the 0.28 October interest counted as income; less the 388.00 pension the funds account applies under the standing authorization; less the fresh credit (capped at the base estimate figure).
REALISM: the resident's Plan K coinsurance share is billed to her on the Medicare record and deducted from her estimated patient pay as an incurred medical expense (42 CFR 435.725(c)(4)(ii)); the October cost of care counts nothing for those days - nothing is collected twice. The billed estimates follow the base formula (2030.00 - 45.00 - 299.30 - 612.00). The October accrual follows the base accrual formula (days in the center x private daily rate).
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root pending_advance_payment (user). One edge -> pending_estimate_cost_cap, value_input, state form: 'The advance toward a coming pending month is worked out only after the estimate of the last closed month stands at no more than that month's cost of care.' False at opening (October estimate 1073.70, no reduction, cost 0.00); only post_pending_cost_of_care_reduction_7ee4a52a posts it. Skipping it gives 1389.08 instead of 315.38.
OVERRIDES: the cost-of-care clause is retired by the three reviews with ONE shared scope sentence; the partial-month clause by the reconciliation and the pending-month review with one shared sentence restating it verbatim; an unscoped month is priced exactly under the base rule at the accrual's days in the center x rate; the base estimate clause is retired only for an advance (billed estimates stay under it); the refund clause only for a fresh credit when a representative pays toward the coming month.
FACTOR CARD (T1 own world; T2 on scratch worlds in worklog round 4): cost cap 1073.70 - pending_coinsurance_day_price (parameter; T1 0.00), pending_privately_held_start (parameter; T1 793.86), pending_declined_hold_days (method; T1 793.86), pending_released_hold_days (method; T1 793.86), pending_days_outside_stay (method; T1 0.00); all-baseline 0.00. Advance 315.38 - pending_projected_coinsurance (method; T1 532.38), pending_premiums_counted (parameter; T1 218.98), pending_interest_counted (parameter; T1 315.10), pending_funds_applied (parameter; T1 703.38), pending_balance_carried_in (method; T1 565.38); all-baseline 1073.70.
NEAR-MISSES: the November estimate (current month); the 1180.00 family check in the funds account (not a pension); the daughter's 250.00 check on the case (a payment, not income); the three documents forwarded (none a health insurance card); the 299.30 premiums on the case versus the premiums counted; the medigap share of October's coinsurance (billed to the carrier, not deducted).
SEED: Harold J. Lindgren, 47 SNF days used earlier in the benefit period (begun 2026-07-08); qualifying stay 10-01 to 10-06; Part A Plan K from 10-06, 23 days booked in October (benefit days 48-70), 2 reversed (10-20/21, recertified 10-22), coinsurance charges 2387.00 each party less 217.00 adjustments, open; emergency room 10-22 with the hold declined (back 10-23); hospital 10-26 on a Medicare-stay private hold released the same day (back 10-28; 1 held day charged, open); application 10-08 requesting 10-01, home maintenance allowance tier; estimates 1073.70 for October (ACH 10-12, paid) and November (the daughter's 250.00 check 11-03, 823.70 open; the standing trust transfer falls due 11-10); October pending accrual 23 days x 398.00 = 9154.00 (pending balance 9154.00); non-Medicaid self-directed funds account from 10-08 with a 1180.00 family check, October interest 0.28, pension 388.00 on 11-01.
PERSONA: Karen E. Moss; volunteers the December pay-ahead goal counting what is open, that October was paid and that she sent 250.00 toward November with the rest open; credentials on request; agrees to corrections; runs the ACH payment for the stated amount.
STANDARD SOLUTION: find/verify -> case, ledger, Medicare episode + ledger, bed-hold reservations + ledger, funds account + ledger -> 1073.70 cost_of_care_cap on October -> hand over the 315.38 ACH advance.
VERIFICATION: scratch ev / t2 / probe scripts (removed at finish) reproduce every figure above; all gates green.
user_scenario: You are Karen E. Moss, Harold J. Lindgren's daughter. Your father, who is 82, has been at the Keystone Ridge center in Lancaster since early October 2026, getting rehab after a hospital stay, and he is in room 327-A; his Medical Assistance application went in in October and is still waiting on a decision, and he plans to go back to his apartment once he is stronger. You keep track of his bills and you are calm and organized, but you are having knee surgery in early December and will be out of commission for a few weeks. So you are calling to settle his patient pay for December now: you want the business office to tell you the amount to send today toward his December patient pay, counting whatever is still open on his account, and you will pay it yourself by ACH on his case today. You have no idea what the right figure is; you only know you paid October's bill and sent a 250.00 check toward this month's bill, and the rest of it is not paid yet. You do not volunteer anything else. When the agent asks for details to find and confirm the account, you give your father's full name, Harold J. Lindgren, and then, as each is asked for, his date of birth, 1944-07-22, and the last four digits of his Social Security number, 3159; if asked for the contact details on file, your phone is 717-555-0317 and your email is karen.moss.lititz@gmail.com, and if asked when he was admitted, it was 2026-10-06. If the agent says something on his account has to be corrected or posted first, you tell them that's fine, please go ahead. You do not want any refund sent and you have no other questions. You never offer a number of your own. When the agent tells you the amount and hands you the payment, you send exactly that amount by ACH on his case, repeat the confirmation number you receive, say thank you and hang up; if the agent says there is nothing to pay, you thank them and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 1073.70 = max(0, 1073.70 - 0.00). October: 31 days at 279.84. Scope: the October accrual counts 23 days in the center; 1 held day on one reservation; the declined leave 10-22 to 10-23 (1 day); the released hold's day 10-27 (1 day); the skilled admission 2026-10-06 (5 days before); 23 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 5 = 31; every Part A day on that coverage -> priced. Lapsed-certification days 2; coinsurance days 23 - 2 = 21, at nothing (billed to the resident and the Plan K carrier, none as crossover). Privately held: the 10-26 Medicare-stay hold -> 10-26 = 1. Declined 1, released 1, before admission 5. Medicaid days 31 - 2 - 21 - 1 - 1 - 1 - 5 = 0 -> cost 0.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.medicaid_case_id: The case id from find_medicaid_cases; one pending case.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.charge_entry_id: The 2026-10 estimated_pending charge: 'the case's patient pay charge with charge basis estimated_pending for that service month' for 'the calendar month before the current month on a case that is pending'.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.adjustment_reason: cost_of_care_cap: 'it is posted against that estimate with reason cost_of_care_cap'. trueup_decrease needs an approval (pending case); not_eligible_month a month outside the requested eligibility (October is the requested month); patient_pay_redetermined a notice (none); billing_error a wrong amount (1073.70 = 2030.00 - 45.00 - 299.30 - 612.00).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the pending-case payment for the daughter.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The payment is the caller's own; the agent unlocks and hands it over with the amount.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The daughter pays 315.38 by ACH on the pending case, naming no charge.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: medicaid_ext_pending_advance_payment computes the advance after the October reduction.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.amount: 315.38 = max(0, 953.38 - 388.00 - 250.00). December estimate: 2030.00 + interest 0.28 (credited 2026-10-31, within the last month) - 45.00 - premiums counted 202.90 (Plan K coverage not QMB-verified, no health insurance card forwarded -> Part B standard premium only) - VA 0.00 - home maintenance allowance 612.00 (December is month 2 from the 2026-10 requested month, under 6) - own coinsurance 217.00 (benefit days used 47 + 21 + 30 November days = 98, 2 days left past the twentieth -> 2 x 217.00 x 50/100) = 953.38. Funds applied: non-Medicaid self-directed account, standing authorization for Medicaid patient pay, pension 388.00 on 2026-11-01 -> 388.00. Balance: 823.70 owed - 1073.70 reduction = 250.00 credit, reduction posted today -> subtracted, capped at the base estimate figure 1073.70 (2030.00 - 45.00 - 299.30 - 0.00 - 612.00) -> 250.00.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.medicaid_case_id: The case id from find_medicaid_cases, given at hand-over.

pending_premiums_counted (parameter, medicare): coverage not QMB-verified and no health insurance card forwarded -> 202.90. Baseline (case premiums 299.30) gives 218.98.

pending_balance_carried_in (method): balance -250.00 after the reduction posted 2026-11-09 -> credit subtracted, capped at the base estimate figure (1073.70) -> -250.00. Baseline gives 565.38.
plain: estimate standard 2030.00 - 45.00 - 299.30 - VA 0.00 - HMA 612.00 (month 2 of 6) changed by the schedules -> 953.38; result 953.38 - 388.00 - 250.00 = 315.38.

edges.condition: The estimated_pending charge of the calendar month before the current month carries a cost_of_care_cap reduction bringing it down to the month's cost of care, wherever that cost is below the estimate.
edges.policy_source: The advance toward a coming pending month is worked out only after the estimate of the last closed month stands at no more than that month's cost of care.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The 2026-10 estimate stands at 1073.70 with no cost_of_care_cap reduction although October's cost of care is 0.00.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The 1073.70 cost_of_care_cap reduction brings the October estimate to 0.00 and the pending case balance to a 250.00 credit from a reduction posted today.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: A single prerequisite edge; no parallel prerequisites.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the October reduction the balance carried is 823.70 owed and the advance is 1389.08 instead of 315.38.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks for the amount to send toward December counting what is open, and agrees to corrections only after the agent says one is needed; it never names October's estimate, cost of care, Medicare days, a hold, a reduction or a credit.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: post_pending_cost_of_care_reduction_7ee4a52a and pay_pending_patient_pay_advance_fe3c809e each create one ledger row and update the case balance; besides refusing a non-positive amount they check nothing, so the payment posts whether or not the reduction exists.
